item.title: America’s Utility Bill Crisis, and Trump’s Approval Rating Hits a New Low
item.description:
Plus, the big business of big scares.

Here’s what we’re covering:

  • This Is What America’s Utility Bill Crisis Looks Like, by Eli Saslow
  • Trump Approval Hits New Low Two Weeks Before Midterms, Poll Finds, by Lisa Lerer and Ruth Igielnik
  • Trump Wields an Unprecedented $277 Million in Final Midterm Stretch, by Theodore Schleifer
  • Trump’s Super PAC Unleashes Deluge of Ads on Facebook and Instagram, by Shane Goldmacher and Theodore Schleifer
  • Trump Says He Asked Putin to Release an American Jailed in Russia, by Luke Broadwater
  • Trump Pushes to Evict the Press From the White House, by Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan
  • Major Yemeni City Running Out of Food and Water as Houthis Encircle It, by Saeed Al-Batati and Vivian Nereim
